id: \bWe honor the Slowpoke that live here.
en: \bWe honor the Slowpoke that live here.

it: Azalina\nDove si vive felici insieme ai Pokémon
\bKurt crea le Ball più originali che ci siano.

id: \bHe made me a Level Ball out of a Red Apricorn.
en: \bHe made me a Level Ball out of a Red Apricorn.
it: \bMi ha fatto una Level Ball con una Ghicocca Rossa.

id: \bWe're mining Charcoal right now. Come back later.
en: \bWe're mining Charcoal right now. Come back later.
it: \bStiamo estraendo Carbonella in questo momento. Torna più tardi.

id: \rMany years ago a Slowpoke yawned and ended a drought. We have honored them ever since.
en: \rMany years ago a Slowpoke yawned and ended a drought. We have honored them ever since.
it: \rMolti anni fa uno Slowpoke sbadigliò e mise fine a una siccità. Da allora li onoriamo.

id: \bBrock: Hey \PN! You came to visit Kurt too? I got a Heavy and Fast Ball from him.
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN! You came to visit Kurt too? I got a Heavy and Fast Ball from him.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN! Anche tu sei venuto a trovare Kurt? Lui mi ha dato una Peso Ball e una Rapid Ball.

id: \bSince you're here, let's have a battle.
en: \bSince you're here, let's have a battle.
it: \bGià che sei qui, facciamo una lotta.

id: \bBrock: Kurt gave me some great balls. As a Breeder this is going to help me big time.
en: \bBrock: Kurt gave me some great balls. As a Breeder this is going to help me big time.
it: \bBrock: Kurt mi ha dato delle Ball fantastiche. Da Allevatore, mi saranno di grande aiuto.
